result.rationale: The diff line `[z.string().toString()]: z.number()` in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts computes the key by calling .toString() on a ZodString, yielding the literal key "[object Object]" rather than an index signature. The following line does the same with `z.unknown().optional()`, overwriting it. So minimumTokenResponseSchema only enforces `access_token` plus a meaningless "[object Object]" property — no expiry invariant — and zod's default strip behavior drops provider fields like expiry_date/refresh_token (which the function then tries to set on the data). This is a real correctness defect intr
